title: 3 Opening Range Breakout Mistakes Every Trader Makes

In this video, I break down the 3 biggest Opening Range Breakout mistakes that cause traders to lose money and show you how to improve your entries using market context, VWAP, and breakout retests. Learn why chasing breakout candles leads to false breakouts, how to use Daily Open VWAP, NY Open VWAP, and Weekly Open VWAP for confirmation, and why the 30-minute opening range and Initial Balance matter for day trading index futures. If you're trading ES, NQ, or other futures markets, these ORB trading tips can help you avoid common traps and improve your risk-to-reward.
